statement: Let score(i) = sum of j over all j with 0 <= j < n and edges[j] = i (empty sum 0). The function returns a result r (it does not fail), and r is an integer node index such that: 0 <= r < n; score(r) >= score(k) for every k with 0 <= k < n; and for every k with 0 <= k < n, if score(k) = score(r) then r <= k. Equivalently, r is the smallest index among all nodes whose edge score is maximal.
preconditions: n = len(edges); 2 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= edges[i] < n and edges[i] != i.
